transcript.purpose: Aligned 18pt base; ordinary reading uses independent 14–28pt preference.

suggestion.purpose: 16pt medium, selected semibold; stacks if long.

context.purpose: Selected suggestion only, 5pt extra line spacing.

control.purpose: 13pt controls; primary style uses medium weight.

editor.purpose: 16pt monospaced in optional correction sheet only.

motion.name: responsive-columns
motion.purpose: Animate the native source-column collapse/expansion only; direct resize and reading stay immediate. Latest target wins on reversal.

motion.name: inspector-selection-scroll
motion.purpose: Reveal selected pending suggestion in inspector.

breakpoints.name: compact-sidebar
breakpoints.behavior: Initial layout switches at 1180pt; live resize collapses below 1156pt and expands at 1204pt. Within the 48pt buffer retain the current composition. Review inspector stays present.

native.appearance: Default dark; light and system options use dynamic NSColor. Native sidebar and inspector materials follow their NSSplitViewItem roles; photographs retain their paper color.
native.semanticColorExport: Frontmatter RGB values are exact WorkspaceStyle sRGB branches. NSColor.textColor/systemPurple and SwiftUI secondary/orange/green remain native semantic colors, not fixed web swatches.

spelling.treatment: Muted solid underline and plain Chinese category label without a leading symbol; selected issue uses focus color.

grammar.treatment: Muted solid underline and plain Chinese category label without a leading symbol; selected issue uses focus color.

recognition-uncertainty.treatment: Photo word fill 0.10 and dotted stroke 0.80; transcript dotted underline. Independent visibility preference, default off; existing explicit choices retained.

word-focus.treatment: Photo fill 0.08 with 3pt outset/rounded outline; aligned-text focus fill 0.12; reading selection uses selectionColor alpha 0.60.

selection.treatment: Sidebar filter 0.55, selected job uses native List selection, selected suggestion 0.38, aligned line 0.15; view toolbar selection uses the system appearance.

colorRules.recovery: System orange: affected-stage recovery, unsaved review and stale-position history; not a language-error color.
colorRules.ready: System green plus ready status label.

window.windowStyle: titleBar; retain system double-click behavior, hide only duplicate title text
window.titleStyle: Native leading document-column filename; retained NSWindow logical title; no centered principal title.

trailingActions.style: NSToolbar native export menu and prominent completion item; system glass on macOS 26+.
trailingActions.alignment: Column headings align to 20pt content leading edge; controls use system toolbar margins.
trailingActions.statusLocation: Teacher progress/save state in 44pt document footer.

sidebar.compactBehavior: Assignment picker popover with search/filter/import; initial threshold 1180pt, live resize keeps current composition within 1156–1204pt. No manual close toggle.
sidebar.style: NSSplitViewItem.sidebar native material; native List.sidebar without custom material overlay.

inspector.style: NSSplitViewItem.inspector, persistent and noncollapsible; system material with full-height native titlebar section.
inspector.compactBehavior: Always present; document minimum 440pt and inspector minimum 300pt.

workplane.structure: Three persistent native column hosts; no inset rounded shell or overlay divider.

pairedViewport.scrollSynchronization: NSClipView bounds.origin sync in both axes; stacked retains source/transcript positions.

transcriptFlow.linePosition: Common median body left edge within each page/reading region; source y with non-overlap.
transcriptFlow.physicalRows: Shared document expands instead of additional soft wrapping.

wordFocus.priority: Intersecting words first; line fallback only with transcript.isAligned && line.hasGeometry. No guessed coordinates.
wordFocus.partialAlignment: Unknown prefixes retain text without borrowing the first known handwriting row; only available body geometry is used.

layout.modePicker: NSToolbarItemGroup with five presentations; automatic representation in wide layout, fixed native collapsed menu in compact layout. Replace only the group on composition changes so AppKit remeasures the new representation; restore selected/disabled state.
layout.windowTitle: 作业批改 — original imported filename with extension; no job: 作业批改

interaction.importShortcut: command-o; native source toolbar, compact picker, empty document and drag/drop.
interaction.controlStates: Native hover/focus/pressed/disabled, except primary button pressed opacity 0.8. No custom decorative transition.
interaction.annotation: 确认 / 放弃 persists TeacherDecision; original transcript is unchanged; next pending issue selected. 已确认项 contains annotation decisions only; discarded history is available from the trailing trash icon.
interaction.history: Only restore an anchored decision with a semantic match in current issues. Legacy dismissed decisions derive stable identity from the issue. Stale or unmatched decisions remain history; revision-stale entries show 位置待确认.
interaction.completion: Machine .complete means analysis complete. Explicit teacher completion sets completedAt; pending issues require keep-remaining confirmation. Decision edits reopen review. Comment editing entry removed; existing saved comments remain readable/exportable. Current job and filter remain; Next action selects next nonreviewed job.
interaction.undoRedo: Native responder-chain undo/redo and command-z / shift-command-z; toolbar validation also disables actions while review save is in flight.
interaction.persistence: Teacher decisions, comments and completion in assignment record; reading presentation/zoom/offset/selection in separate ReadingState, debounced 350ms. Search/filter are view-local, not restart-persistent.
interaction.saveFailure: Keep in-memory edits; show 尚未保存 and 重试保存. Completion and application termination are blocked until review save succeeds. Reading-state save failures do not mask review-save error.
interaction.wipe: Disabled without alignment. Drag, arrow-key/AX increment-decrement in 5% steps; Home=0%, End=100%.
interaction.editing: Optional transcript correction sheet; save re-reviews. Normal model flow does not wait for word-by-word human confirmation.
interaction.assignmentDeletion: Sidebar context menu or Delete, then system Trash confirmation; imported source unchanged; active/loading or saving work cannot delete.
interaction.jevDetails: Expanded bottom stage strip while running; completion status popover → Jev stage. Consistency scores, candidate attempts, historical scan version and retry; not an essay grade.
interaction.reviewDiscarded: Trailing trash icon beside the segmented control; anchored popover; disabled when empty.

reviewUnadopted.entry: N 条模型建议未采用; rejectedIssues + deferredReviewIssues.count; popover anchored above this footer button
reviewUnadopted.historicalRecovery: When stored proposals have recoverable exact literal matches, reanchor existing results without invoking a model. Keep legacy missing-reason explanation.
reviewUnadopted.modelBoundary: MiniCPM5-2B authors suggestions and reasons; reanchor repairs indices, not semantics.

interaction.readabilityWarning: One line above content; edit becomes 核对原文 for difficult homework. Uses independent word-image and page evidence; no handwriting grade.
interaction.completionShortcut: command-return; same validation and pending-issue confirmation as toolbar

settings.services: All-three-model download/start/stop with individual readiness rows; separate confirmed Trash operation for model storage. Download confirmation explains approximately 5.94 GB and local path; resumable determinate progress.
settings.advanced: Local-only endpoints, model directory picker, reference threshold, attempts 1–3, same-row save outcome.
settings.scope: Competition local models remain MiniCPM-OCR F16, Jev Q4_K_M, MiniCPM5-2B Q4_K_M; API edition excluded.

rendererBoundary.screenRenderer: TextDrawing + TranscriptPageView; ReadingDocumentView has separate wrapping flow.
rendererBoundary.contract: Jev white-background candidate renderer is separate from screen theme, zoom, reading preferences and annotations.

native.previewPolicy: Self-contained HTML/CSS are synthetic panel illustrations only: 1px stands for one logical pt. macOS materials, segmented controls, SF Symbols, focus and native outlines remain platform-owned; do not copy preview CSS into SwiftUI as new design tokens.
native.rampPolicy: Eight-step OKLCH ramps are derived panel swatches only, not extra native colors or theme branches.

designAuthority.layoutReference: The approved HTML remains a content-organization reference; the user superseded its inset outer shell with Device Hub native columns.

pendingAcceptance.scope: Responsive workspace implementation and runtime evidence; remaining native interaction and accessibility acceptance.
pendingAcceptance.owner: Current implementation owner; next manual session supplies pointer-resize and system accessibility observations.
targets: 保留系统交通灯、窗口拖动、键盘快捷键与菜单行为；顶部按钮可独立操作，不与拖动区域争夺点击。
顶部与中央／右侧连续工作面在材质和空间关系上融合，避免出现另加一层网页导航栏的割裂感。
文档标题位于工作面所属区域，不跨越侧栏与工作面的接缝；长文件名在可用区域内处理，不挤占窗口控制或主操作。
“完成批阅”主操作固定在右上；完成后的“下一份”沿用这一位置，不随标题长度或侧栏显隐漂移。
作业列表图标对齐文件名首行，状态另起一行；多行内容不以整行垂直居中造成图标上下跳动。
已发现问题／已确认项控件有完整可见、可点击并可键盘操作的高度；文字、选中态与焦点轮廓不被垂直裁切。
pendingAcceptance.updatePermissionContinuity: Development certificate, bundle ID and designated requirement preserved by build script. Formal Documents grant reuse was not exercised in this isolated UI session.
pendingAcceptance.geometryPolicy: No in-progress titlebar offsets, heights or other experimental measurements are promoted into design tokens.
pendingAcceptance.status: User accepted the complete feedback revision on 2026-11-06 as formal version 0.1.3 (4), and authorized GitHub synchronization and old-build cleanup. API edition is paused. See docs/COLLABORATION.md; remaining accessibility coverage is recorded separately.

narrative.overview:
原稿是证据，识别稿承载阅读，右侧建议支持教师判断。保留来源列表、中央画布和右侧工具区的连续桌面关系，以中性近黑工作面、原生材质侧栏和低对比列表组织内容；蓝色用于主操作、当前视图与字词焦点，不把整个界面染成蓝黑外壳。

默认深色，提供浅色和跟随系统。系统字体、自然字形与平面文稿让老师看清原文、建议和自己的处理结果；机器“分析完成”与教师“已批阅”分别呈现。

窗口结构、工具栏分组及材质以 Device Hub 为直接参照；HTML 保留为内容组织依据。采用系统 Liquid Glass 操作层，文稿正文保持平整。设计依据见 Apple 的 [Layout](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/layout)、[Toolbars](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/toolbars) 与 [Designing for macOS](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/designing-for-macos)。
keyCharacteristics: 原生 macOS 窗口、材质、菜单、设置和键盘操作。
原生导航栏、内容栏和检查器；窄窗以作业选择入口替代来源栏，正文与检查器始终保留。
对照保留物理行并共享平移缩放；普通阅读独立软换行。
当前建议单项展开；教师决定和保存状态清晰可见。

rules.name: The Separate Signals Rule
rules.body: 蓝色表示主操作、当前视图与当前字词焦点；柔和莓红和赭金分别表示拼写、语法问题；系统紫色点线表示识别疑义，三者不混用。

rules.name: The Paper Is Content Rule
rules.body: 照片保留纸面颜色，不随应用深色外观反相；滑动对照中的转写使用白底黑字，以同画布分界呈现两种内容。

rules.name: The Natural Glyph Rule
rules.body: 不逐行追随手写偏移，不拉伸或压缩字形；对照保留完整物理行，普通阅读才按视口软换行。

rules.name: The Shared Coordinates Rule
rules.body: 左右、上下与滑动对照共享文档坐标、平移和缩放；切换布局不改写原文或批注。

rules.name: The Native Depth Rule
rules.body: 界面层使用系统材质和原生呈现；文稿内部保持平面，不用装饰性阴影制造层级。

rules.name: The Word First Rule
rules.body: 先定位与建议原文范围相交的词区；没有词区时，仅在转写已对齐且对应行有可靠几何时回退到行，不猜测缺失坐标。

rules.name: The Teacher Completion Rule
rules.body: 分析完成只说明机器流程结束；教师明确完成后才进入已批阅，余下建议须经确认放弃，保存失败不能当成完成。

dos: Do 沿用系统字体、SF Symbols、原生菜单与焦点反馈，并提供深色、浅色和跟随系统。
Do 在窄窗保留自然字号；物理行对照用共同画布横滚，普通阅读用软换行。
Do 先显示原词 → 建议，只展开当前项的整句上下文、中文依据与教师动作。
Do 保留导入、重复提醒、废纸篓确认、校对、复制、导出、阶段重试和 Jev 详情。
Do 区分待确认建议、已确认批注、已放弃建议和已批阅，并就地显示保存中、已保存或失败重试。
donts: Don't 用添加批注替换学生原文，或把逐字人工核对设为正常作业继续审核的门槛。
Don't 缩小字或变形字形来掩盖物理行重叠，也不要在缺少可靠几何时画猜测词框。
Don't 让所有建议同时展开、所有问题同时铺色，或用颜色代替类别、文字与线型。
Don't 把 Jev 数值包装成作文分数，或把真实应用截图、合成快照与模型质量证据混为一谈。
Don't 为复制网页外观另造假标题栏、网页设置弹层或文稿装饰阴影；保留原生圆角、材质和控件。
Don't 为无当前匹配的历史记录提供会删掉记录却不产生待处理项的恢复动作。
